author: Esiymbro
title: Provinces and commanderies of the Han Dynasty in 219 CE
modifications: Original SVG unchanged. Five legend/separator paths excluded; 138 geographic paths extracted and affinely registered against the original topographic tile family; Chinese label transcription and chronology caveats added. The application uses an unlabelled extracted terrain raster rather than embedding the Latin artwork.
limitations: Some province borders are post-220 divisions. Yiyang chronology and short-lived Linchuan identity require correction. Registered lines are research data, not verified ancient cadastral boundaries or faction control polygons.
